_doc: Move-purity manifest. Each target declares the original file and its replacement PARTS, where every part records the ORIGINAL LINE RANGE it covers. catdiff.js asserts: (A) each part's bytes equal the pristine original's bytes for that range, (B) the ranges tile 1..N with no gap or overlap, (C) concatenating them reproduces the whole original byte-for-byte, and (D) for client targets, the <script src> order parsed out of the real 'orderFrom' file equals the parts' ascending line order. Order is derived from the real HTML, never trusted from this file -- a disagreement between the two is reported as the bug. Check [5] (scriptblock.js) additionally validates the script block itself.
_lineEndings: This repo has core.autocrlf=true: files are CRLF on disk, LF in git blobs (app.js is 891641 bytes on disk vs 874347 in the blob -- exactly one extra byte per line). RAW byte-identity is MANDATORY for client parts; CRLF->LF is used only as a failure diagnostic and can never produce a PASS.
